picks.title: Walking the Path of the Ancestors
picks.summary: What happens as Autumn approaches and the light begins to fade? In this episode, Roshi John Tarrant speaks to the seasonal descent we make with each great turning and the opportunity it provides for returning to the source, the eternal. Speaking on a number of koans that fall into the category of Mysterious Tasks & Impossible Problems, Tarrant guides listeners through stories of great mythic figures and illuminates the path we must each take up to be closer to the ancestors. picks.title: BITESIZE | A Monk’s Guide To Finding Happiness & Thriving in Hard Times | Gelong Thubten #678
picks.summary:
What if the most courageous, compassionate thing you could do in life, was to learn how to be with yourself? It’s a powerful, perhaps surprising idea put forward by today’s guest.



Today’s Bitesize is from episode 387 of the podcast with Gelong Thubten - Buddhist monk, meditation teacher and author of the fantastic book 'A Handbook for Hard Times: A Monk’s Guide to Fearless Living’.



Thubten became a monk back in 1993 after suffering from severe physical and mental burnout whilst following his dream of becoming an actor in New York City.
